text:
Ava: Quick ask — we need a single-sentence microformat kit for the webinar landing page + social. Think: one hero tile, 3 microcards, 2 speaker tiles.
Samir: timeline?
Ava: Can we get first pass by Wed EOD? webinar is next Tue. Need localization-friendly layouts (short and long copy)
Diego: I can do hero + microcards. Do we have final copy? Also need the exact logo lockups for APAC partners.
Lina: I'll upload the latest logo package to Figma and add the localization copy sheet.
Diego: Thanks. Pinged @Ava in Figma. Using 1200x628 / 1080x1080 / 600x314 for outputs.
Ava: Yep those formats. Also include an SVG icon set (6 icons) and a 1-slide explainer diagram showing "inference economics" flow — simple arrows + labels.
Samir: For social A/B: long headline vs short headline. Can we get both variants exported with alt copy? Also need 30s webinar gif hero.
Diego: GIF timeline + assets: export frames at 30fps, keep file <3MB. Will prototype in After Effects.
LegalBot: Automated notice — please run accessibility and trademark check on logos. Use legal/checklist/v2.docx
Lina: Legal flagged partner logo color variants. @Diego pls use mono lockup fallback when in doubt.
Ava: Final deliverables: 1) hero PNGs (3 sizes) 2) 3 microcards (social, email, blog) 3) speaker tiles (2) 4) svg icon set 5) 1-slide diagram (editable svg) 6) 30s gif hero
Samir: Priorities: hero + diagram first, then microcards. If we need to pare back, drop GIF.
Diego: On it. ETA Wed 5pm PT for hero + diagram. Will add Figma links + exported file names in thread when ready.
Ava: Thanks — also flag any brand compliance questions here; don't create variants without approval. :thumbsup:
Diego: uploading first comps now — link: https://www.figma.com/file/xxxx/microformat-kit
Ava: Received, will review and loop in legal if needed.
